img.alt: Inali Foundation: CSR campaigns in 2 days, not 7

div.p: Mobile App Development, Workflow Automation
Inali Foundation
Non-profit, healthcare
Project details
A non-profit that has provided thousands of accessible prosthetic arms across India, funded through CSR partnerships.

Patient registration, appointments, CSR campaigns, inventory and staff tasks all ran on paper and spreadsheets. Pulling a campaign report took days, and the foundation nearly lost a major recurring CSR partner because of it. The founder couldn’t see inventory, fitments or campaign status without waiting for someone to compile the data.

img.alt: From spreadsheet chaos to one live view of patients, inventory and campaigns.

div.p: One mobile and web app for the whole operation: patient registration and records, appointment booking with automatic reminders, CSR campaign tracking with updates for partners, real-time inventory, vendor and partner profiles, and role-based dashboards for CSR managers, doctors, supervisors, lead managers and inventory managers.
Campaign turnaround fell from 7 days to 2. Every team works from the same live data, partners see progress without asking, and the foundation can serve more people.

A temple that issues passes for visitors to attend its events and ceremonies.
Passes were checked by hand at the entrance: slow, error-prone and frustrating for visitors at busy events.

Entry is faster, verification errors are gone, and staff can see how many passes have been issued and used.

div.p: A platform where donors offer items (laptops, phones, stationery, food) and recipients ask for help through simple forms with OTP verification; an admin check on every request; verified posts shared automatically on Telegram and Facebook; and donor–recipient matching that protects privacy.
More than 1,000 people received verified help, from laptops and phones to food and essentials.
